cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says two or more programmes draw their beneficiaries from the RSPM in use, or that it is linked to civil registration, health, education or tax.
cells.note: In March 2026 the World Bank said the e-ID is fully interoperable with the RSPM social registry and authenticates Novissi cash-transfer beneficiaries, so a registry exchanges data in use. No second programme drawing on the shared registry is shown, so not 4.
